revise.title: Stories that lead to gifts and tours
revise.lead: Short local stories, written by the shop in English and German, bring guests from reading about Lucerne to buying a gift or booking a tour.
callouts: Stories in the guest's language
The list shows only stories in the chosen language, so a guest never meets a half-translated page.
Blog-style article pages
A large cover, the author, photos, a video and sound, all written by the shop.
Linked gifts and tours
Each story ends with the tour and gift the shop chose, in the order the shop set.

revise.title: Trip advice from the shop's assistant
revise.lead: A chat asks the guest the questions the shop has set up, then sends the answers to the team, who reply by email.
callouts: One question at a time
Counters, dates and choices appear in the conversation, so a guest answers without typing long text.
Answers go to the team
The assistant asks only the shop's questions and gives no plan; staff read the answers and reply by email.
One tap away
A floating button on home, tours and stories opens the chat, no sign-in needed.

revise.title: Manage your referral partners
revise.lead: Partners are hotels, guides or others who send you guests; each gets a personal link and QR code so you can see what their guests buy.
callouts: Search and filter partners
Find a partner by name, code or email, or show only those you still owe commission.
Link opens, never 'scans'
The list counts how often each link was opened in 30 days, plus the guests who then bought.
Source on every sale
A guest who opens a partner link sees the normal shop; their orders for the next 30 days count for that partner.

revise.title: Commissions and payouts, fully tracked
revise.lead: The shop records each payment to a partner, and the partner sees the same figures in a private report without any guest contact details.
callouts: Pay what is owed
The amount to pay starts at what is still owed after offsets; the Owner or Manager picks method, date and a reference.
Offsets are not payments
If a refund lowers commission already paid, the next commissions are offset first and never shown as money paid.
Partner's own report
Day, week or month totals, commission paid and owed, with guest names only and no email, phone or notes.

revise.title: See which channels and guests convert
revise.lead: Reports show how many visitors become buyers, split by partner and by four guest groups, so you can see where marketing time pays off.
callouts: Filters
Narrow any report by period, source, goods or tours, guest group, or a single product or tour.
The sales funnel
Steps run from link opened to completed, with the share lost at each step.
Four guest groups, one 'unknown'
Guests we cannot place are counted as not determined; partial tracking shows its coverage instead of a lower count.

revise.title: Best sellers, operations and margin
revise.lead: See what sells, how deliveries and tours are going, and what you really earn, counting only sales whose costs are all entered.
callouts: Best sellers
Products, variants and tours ranked, with stock and seat figures beside them.
Operations
Delivered, no-show and cancelled counts, plus how stories and the advice chat perform.
Margin needs known costs
Collected money minus refunds and costs; sales with missing costs are listed and left out, never guessed.

new.title: Stories with video, sound and a contents bar
new.lead: Articles read like a travel blog: a contents bar follows the reader, video loads only when tapped, and a story in the other language is flagged.
phones: Bar highlights the section being read
A notice explains the text language
callouts: Contents bar follows you
Section chips stay at the top and highlight where the reader is; a tap jumps to that section.
Video loads on tap
The YouTube video downloads only after a tap, so pages stay fast; audio plays right in the article.
Comments need sign-in
Guests read comments freely; writing one asks them to sign in and returns them to the same article.

new.title: Trip advice: skip, email, send
new.lead: The chat shows each answer as a message, lets guests skip optional questions, and asks for an email so the team can reply.
new.badge: Questions are set by the shop
phones: Marked Optional, with a Skip button
Every answer has a Change link

new.title: Add a partner and print their QR code
new.lead: Adding a partner takes four fields; the shop then gets a QR code and link to hand out, and every guest who opens it is credited.
callouts: Four fields
Name, type (hotel, guide or other), the email that receives report codes, and a short referral code.
QR code to download
Save the QR code as a PNG for flyers or desks, or copy the link to share online.
Credit for 30 days
A guest who opens the link sees the normal home page; their orders in the next 30 days count for the partner.

new.title: Compare partners side by side
new.lead: The Analytics tab shows which partners bring visitors and buyers, so you can decide where to spend time and which ones to reward.
callouts: Four headline figures
Link opens, partner transactions, conversion and commission earned, each against the previous period.
Opens per day
A daily chart shows when each partner's links were used, so a busy weekend stands out.
Partners compared
Each partner's opens, transactions, conversion and commission sit in one list for the chosen period.

new.title: Refund offsets and report link control
new.lead: When a refund cuts commission you already paid, the shop owes nothing until later commissions cover it, and the Owner can cut off a partner's report.
callouts: Never a negative payout
Hotel am See shows CHF 0.00 to pay and CHF 11.10 to offset; payments restart once later commissions cover it.
Ledger shows each step
Every sale, offset and payout appears in a dated list, newest first.
Revoke needs confirmation
Only the Owner can revoke a report link; it stops working at once on every device, and a new one can follow.

new.title: How a partner opens their report
new.lead: Partners need no account: a private link plus a six-digit code sent to their email opens a report that only they can see.
callouts: Link plus emailed code
The page shows only a masked email; Send code mails a six-digit code that works for 10 minutes.
Wrong codes are limited
A wrong code shows an error and how many tries are left; too many asks for a new code.
Kept for 30 days
After the code, the same browser reopens the report directly for 30 days; a forwarded link still asks for a code.

new.title: What the partner sees: paid, owed, orders
new.lead: The report separates money actually paid from commission merely estimated, and lists each order the partner brought, so there is little to argue about.
callouts: Paid, refunded, offset
Payments received, refund reductions and offsets are listed apart, with CHF still to offset.
By product group
Commission is split by tours, knives, gift boxes and prints, recorded and estimated shown in two shades.
Orders without contact data
Each order shows guest name, products, value, status and commission; open orders say Estimated, not recorded.

new.title: Filter every report
new.lead: One filter sheet narrows all report tabs, so you can ask questions such as how tours sold through one guide to one guest group.
callouts: Period first
Choose 7 days, 30 days or this month; figures are compared with the previous period of the same length.
Four filters
Source (a partner or direct), goods or tours, guest group, and one product or tour.
Goods and tours stay apart
Money cards always count goods and tours separately and never add them into one revenue figure.

new.title: Enter costs to unlock margin
new.lead: Margin is only shown for sales with every cost entered, so the shop fills in the gaps, and the report updates at once.
callouts: Five cost types
Cost of goods, packaging, payment fee, delivery and other variable costs, per completed order or booking.
Empty is missing, not zero
An empty field stays flagged; the shop enters an amount or ticks that it doesn't apply (0).
Coverage goes up
After saving packaging for one sale, margin covers 80 of 84 completed sales instead of 79.
